test_inputs.explanation: product_id was taken directly from the admin edit URLs visited (.../edit/id/2796/). All other fields are valid, typical Magento product values chosen so the same edit flow can be replayed: name/sku are identifiable strings for this product id, weight/price/qty use common numeric formats, status and stock_availability use the allowed visible texts, visibility uses a valid option, and website_ids includes the default site (1). Optional category_ids was left out.
